_comment: Static dataset registry. 'documented' URLs were copied from the official portal page on 2026-10-04 but never downloaded from the build environment. 'candidate' URLs are NOT verified: the pipeline tries them once, records the real outcome, and falls back to data/manual/<id>/.

static.title: State Boundary (states and UTs)
static.organisation: NWIC National Water Data Portal (producer metadata: Geological Survey of India; page branding: Survey of India)
static.licence: Portal copyright policy: free reuse with prominent source acknowledgement; no dataset-level licence field shown
static.limitations: Not confirmed as the legal external boundary of India. Analysis use only; do not present as an official map.

static.title: District Boundary
static.organisation: NWIC National Water Data Portal (producer metadata: Geological Survey of India; page branding: Survey of India)
static.licence: Portal copyright policy: free reuse with prominent source acknowledgement; no dataset-level licence field shown
static.limitations: District boundaries change; check the data date. Not an official map.

static.title: River Network (river lines)
static.organisation: Central Water Commission (CWC) via NWIC National Water Data Portal
static.coverage: Rivers (completeness not stated by the portal)
static.licence: 'Other (Open)' on the resource page; acknowledge source
static.limitations: Flow direction and connectivity are not documented. Used here only for river NAMES, never for downstream tracing.

static.title: Glacial Lakes (Himalayan states)
static.organisation: Central Water Commission (CWC) via NWIC National Water Data Portal
static.licence: No dataset-level licence field shown; acknowledge source
static.limitations: Static inventory. Current lake change is only in CWC monthly PDF reports (manual).

static.title: HydroRIVERS v1.0 - Asia (river reaches with downstream links)
static.organisation: HydroSHEDS (WWF, McGill University and partners) - international gap-filler
static.licence: HydroSHEDS licence agreement: free with attribution (read it on hydrosheds.org)
static.limitations: Built from ~500 m terrain data: small Himalayan streams are missing; discharge values are MODELLED long-term averages. Candidate URL unverified: the pipeline records whether it worked.

static.title: HydroBASINS - Asia (basin hierarchy)
static.licence: HydroSHEDS licence agreement: free with attribution
static.limitations: Optional. Direct URL not verified; place ZIPs in data/manual/hydrobasins_asia/. Indian official basin boundaries (25 basins / 101 sub-basins) have no verified download.

static.title: WorldPop population count 2020, 1 km, India
static.organisation: WorldPop, University of Southampton - international gap-filler (Census village data is not accessible)
static.licence: WorldPop open licence (CC BY 4.0 per WorldPop; verify on the download page)
static.limitations: Modelled estimate, not a census. Candidate URL unverified.

static.title: OpenStreetMap India extract (places, roads, bridges, dams)
static.licence: ODbL: attribution and share-alike apply to derived databases
static.limitations: Crowd-sourced: incomplete in mountain areas, bridge tagging uneven. Candidate URL unverified.

static.title: Land cover (ESA WorldCover 10 m tiles or NRSC Bhuvan LULC)
static.limitations: Tiles are large; place those covering the Himalayan arc in data/manual/landcover/. Cropland/built-up exposure is computed only where tiles exist.

static.title: Protected areas / wetlands / forest polygons
static.limitations: No verified programmatic download. Place vector files in data/manual/ecosystems/; exposure is computed only for files present.
